actions: tutorial:caption:1. Start with the Trainer example. Add one Label.
tutorial:caption:Content changes the words. Font Size changes the letters.
tutorial:caption:Layout sets the final position, box size and front/back order.
tutorial:caption:Switch tabs to keep the typed values before scrubbing or playback.
tutorial:caption:The first frame can be invisible during Fade In. Scrub forward.
tutorial:caption:2. Animation controls WHEN the selected Label is visible.
tutorial:caption:Start X is outside the Stage. Final X is the arrival position.
tutorial:caption:Switch tabs to keep the values, then Restart from the beginning.
tutorial:caption:Scrub before the start: hidden. Scrub inside the interval: visible.
tutorial:caption:3. Actors are models. Select Player or Opponent before editing.
tutorial:caption:Audio has separate Intro and Battle cues.
tutorial:caption:Save As creates your own file. Keep the supplied presets as templates.
tutorial:caption:4. Region copies a loaded building into the presentation.
tutorial:caption:Capture region stores the block shape. The world is unchanged.
tutorial:caption:Particles -> Add layer -> Emit defines one particle layer.
tutorial:caption:Play checks the Stage, models and particle timing together.
tutorial:caption:Capture is an editing step. Save the presentation to keep it.
